title: 第4章 听老太太指挥
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
魏建业看媳妇给折腾得只剩下半条命也很挫败。

    是他不好，明知道那地方艰苦，为了跟家里人团聚还非要开这个口。

    黑暗中，蔡老太老神在在地说：“行了，再坚持一下，前面就到了。”

    当婆婆的话还是好使的，赵玉兰情绪稍稍稳定，抬头往远处指着：“是不是前面啊。”

    也是头一回来，压根不知道哪是哪的蔡老太坚定不移地点点头，告诉儿媳妇没错，就是那！

    天上乌云又多了，甚至还打了声闷雷。

    谁都有些紧张，海上遇到雷雨天可不是啥好事啊。

    苗苗却咯咯咯地笑出声，啵得啵得地说：“打雷就是老天爷在过节。”

    小破孩嘴里还‘噼里啪啦蹦恰蹦恰’的喊，笃定说：“就跟咱家过新年放鞭炮是一样的。”

    虽说当着孩子的面不好表现得太严肃，但童言童语反叫几个大人心里都冷静了许多。

    几声闷雷之后，到底还是没下雨，适应了发动机轰隆隆的声音后，疲惫万分的赵玉兰和苗苗渐渐入睡。

    蔡老太给孙子孙女掖着衣服，问儿子：“建业，这船还得开多久？”

    “去一趟二十个小时，回来也是二十个小时”魏建业想了想还得添一句，“而且是海况好的时候。”

    还早着呢，顺利的话登岛也是明儿下午的事了。

    蔡老太在内心轻轻叹了口气，也跟着闭上了眼睛。

    全家这一觉就到了隔天早上。

    运输船上管早饭，稀饭加咸菜。

    魏建业去交涉过，末了端过来五个水煮鸡蛋给家里人加餐。

    太阳升起后明显燥热了很多，老的老、小的小又开始脱衣服。

    赵玉兰都想拿夏装给小孩换了。

    魏建业没让，还是叫他们穿着长衣长裤。

    他喊过苗苗，拿了一条毛巾把孩子小脸都给包起来，再掏出一草帽扣上，嗡嗡嗡的说：“不裹严实等会晒伤会很痛。”

    蔡老太帮着孙子孙女折腾好，自己也捂得严严实实，叫大儿媳顾好自己就行。

    赵玉兰闷得慌，偷偷撸起袖子时不时去撩冰凉的海水，一个小时后发现手臂分成两截颜色，晒过的地方像针刺一样疼痛。
content_en:
Wei Jianye was frustrated when he saw that his wife had been tortured to the point where she only had half her life left.

It's his fault. He knew it was a difficult place, but he still had to open his mouth in order to reunite with his family.

In the darkness, Mrs. Cai said calmly: "Okay, just hold on, we'll be there."

The mother-in-law's words were still effective. Zhao Yulan's mood stabilized a little. She raised her head and pointed in the distance: "Is it in front?"

It was also the first time she came back. Mrs. Cai, who had no idea where it was, nodded firmly and told her daughter-in-law that's right, that's it!

There were more dark clouds in the sky, and there was even a muffled thunder.

Everyone is a little nervous. It is not a good thing to encounter a thunderstorm at sea.

Miao Miao giggled loudly and said happily: "Thundering means God is celebrating a holiday."

The little boy kept shouting, "Crackling, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, bang, bang, bang, bang, bang, bang, bang, bang, bang, bang, bang, crack, bang, bang, bang, bang, bang, bang, bang, bang, crack, bang, bang, bang, crack, bang, bang, bang, bang, bang," and said firmly: "It's just like our family setting off firecrackers during the New Year."

Although it was hard to act too serious in front of the children, the children's words made the adults feel much calmer.

After several muffled thunders, it finally stopped raining. After getting used to the rumbling sound of the engine, the exhausted Zhao Yulan and Miao Miao gradually fell asleep.

Mrs. Cai tucked her grandchildren's clothes in and asked her son, "Jianye, how long will it take for this boat to sail?"

"It takes twenty hours to go there, and it takes twenty hours to come back." Wei Jianye thought for a while and added, "And it's when the sea conditions are good."

It's still early. If everything goes well, we can land on the island tomorrow afternoon.

Mrs. Cai sighed softly in her heart and closed her eyes.

The whole family slept until the next morning.

The transport ship provides breakfast, porridge and pickles.

Wei Jianye went to negotiate, and finally brought over five hard-boiled eggs for the family to add to their meal.

After the sun rose, it became obviously much hotter, so the old and the young began to take off their clothes again.

Zhao Yulan even wanted to change her children into summer clothes.

Wei Jianye refused and asked them to wear long clothes and long trousers.

He called Miaomiao, took a towel and wrapped the child's little face, then took out a straw hat and buckled it on, and said hummingly: "If you don't wrap it up tightly, you will get sunburned and it will be very painful."

Mrs. Cai helped her grandson and granddaughter get through the troubles, but she also kept a tight lid on herself and asked her eldest daughter-in-law to take care of herself.

Zhao Yulan was so depressed that she secretly rolled up her sleeves and went to touch the cold sea water from time to time. An hour later, she found that her arm was divided into two parts, and the sunburned area hurt like pinpricks.
title_en: Chapter 4 Listen to the old lady’s instructions
